subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Last night I played my guitar loudly and the neighbours complain.
solution:
The correct answer is "**and the neighbours complain**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence describes the situation of the past.
 
• Also, the verb "played" indicates that the sentence is in past tense.
 
• **The verb "complain" should be in the past tense to match the past tense verb "played" in the first part of the sentence.**
 
• Thus, the verb "complain" will be replaced with the verb "complained.
 
• The correct sentence should be:
 
 
• "Last night I played my guitar loudly and the neighbours complained."
 
 

Hence,** the correct answer is option 2**.
